side.note: estimated from a rear three-quarter still, perspective partly taken out

front.note: estimated from a front three-quarter museum photo

top.note: Traced from the published top orthographic (top-plan). Length is the 5.42 m side trace. Width is scaled to 2.32 m, the front-trace and model box, because the blueprint preview is wider than the car in the photographs. The notch is the open channel. Film overheads are on the sheet; the car is too small in those frames to trace.

legend: White is overlap. Red is reference only. Cyan is model only.
alignment: Uniform scale. Side and top align nose-to-nose and ground or centreline. Front aligns ground and centre. The model is not stretched to the reference box.
